title: Trigger pass can append two active crises for one (archetype, set-piece) activation on a single tick — (a)+(c) double-fire
detail: r2's post-trigger `continue` guaranteed at-most-one-per-activation; the N4 restructure removed it. A tick with both a bound lane and a pool drop appends two active rows for one activation, violating the frozen Dedup letter.
recommended_fix: Re-check `crisis_active_for` (or `continue` to the next set-piece) after every successful `crisis_trigger`, so the pool backstop cannot fire on top of a same-tick (a)/(b) trigger.

title: STILL-PRESENT: types.odin:295 keeps the false 'pre-3.3/3.4/4.1/4.2 event streams stay byte-identical' claim the W3 amendment was to remove
detail: The W3-carry mandate requires types.odin to match serialize.odin's admission. It now admits the +4B fold two lines above yet still claims pre-4.2 streams stay byte-identical — false for any drop-bearing stream; the amendment is self-contradictory.
recommended_fix: Reword the trailing sentence to serialize.odin's: drop-bearing pre-4.2 streams are NOT byte-identical (the documented +4B fold); only streams without Packet_Dropped events stay byte-identical.
